title: Six-material Layer-ROM versus same-partition CoRichards hydrological decomposition
question: For the frozen six-material fixed-head transfer panel, how much of the Layer-ROM error pattern is shared with conventional Richards on the same vertical partition, and how much appears only after replacing the Richards spatial operator by the layer closure?

B1H_reference_and_LARE.rule: Use immutable per-material B1H R16 Reference and persisted B1H LARE summaries. Do not regenerate or retune Layer-ROM trajectories.

B1HCQ_CoRichards.rule: Use only O0 scientific stdout from cells already qualified O0/O2-identical in B1HC-Q.

component_relation: COR_STRICTLY_BETTER: CoRichards error < Layer-ROM error - tolerance.
LARE_STRICTLY_BETTER: Layer-ROM error < CoRichards error - tolerance.

vector_relation.COR_COMPONENTWISE_NO_WORSE: CoRichards is no worse on every declared vector component and strictly better on at least one.
vector_relation.LARE_COMPONENTWISE_NO_WORSE: Layer-ROM is no worse on every declared vector component and strictly better on at least one.
vector_relation.NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT: Every component is equal within the frozen numerical tolerance.

comparison_contract.same_partition_gap: For nonnegative magnitude metrics report Layer-ROM error minus CoRichards error as a descriptive gap only.
comparison_contract.nonadditivity_firewall: Do not call the same-partition gap an additive closure error. CoRichards discretization and Layer-ROM model-form errors may interact or compensate.

B05_dimension4_counterexample.question: Does B05 L4 remain difficult under same-partition Richards, or is the B1H L4 failure predominantly introduced by the layer closure?
B05_dimension4_counterexample.rule: Report the complete L4 vector for both routes. Do not add U4 CoRichards after seeing this result.

B02_B16_nonmonotone_exchange.question: Do the B1H L6-to-R8 cumulative-exchange/storage tradeoffs on B02 and B16 also occur in same-partition Richards?
B02_B16_nonmonotone_exchange.rule: Compare the frozen L4/L6/R8 dimension ordering separately for each response component; no scalar monotonicity score.

high_dimension_floor.question: At R8 across transfer materials, does CoRichards continue toward Reference while Layer-ROM approaches a nonzero exchange/flux floor?
high_dimension_floor.rule: Report per-material R8 component gaps. No universal floor is inferred from six materials.

adjudication_rules.closure_model_form_signal: A material/member has a broad Layer-ROM-specific burden only when CoRichards is componentwise no-worse on the six-component groundwater vector with at least one strict improvement. Profile/state components remain separately reported.
adjudication_rules.discretization_signal: A component whose CoRichards error remains comparable to or worse than Layer-ROM under the frozen relation is not attributable to Layer-ROM closure/model-form alone.
adjudication_rules.dimension_order_transfer: For each route separately report whether every individual error component is nonincreasing from L4 to L6 to R8. A route may be monotone for one purpose component and nonmonotone for another.
adjudication_rules.B05_interpretation: Do not infer a new partition from B05. The decomposition only decides whether the targeted-L4 failure is shared with same-partition Richards or predominantly Layer-ROM-specific.
adjudication_rules.successor_if_LARE_specific: If same-partition CoRichards is broadly no-worse for the difficult cells/materials, authorize a teacher-forced fixed-head operator localization diagnostic before inventing new state.
adjudication_rules.successor_if_shared: If the dominant difficult-cell errors and dimension tradeoffs persist in CoRichards, prioritize representation/partition/discretization study rather than closure retuning.

output_requirements: per material x member x checkpoint Layer-ROM and CoRichards response vectors
per component same-partition relation and descriptive gap
per route dimension-order monotonicity by component
B02 and B16 L6-to-R8 exchange/storage diagnostic
no pooled ranking as primary decision
